title: Surreal Bloody Kitchen
description: A surreal scene viewed through a circular broken mosaic frame reveals a blood-splattered kitchen and living area. A man in a blue shirt stands at the kitchen island while a large red rat with exposed brain stands on its hind legs beside a green refrigerator; a brown recliner sits in a pool of blood with shoes on the checkered floor and a bloody moon-faced wall clock above.
prompt: Surreal horror scene of a blood-splattered yellow kitchen with a man standing at the island counter, a giant red rat with exposed brain standing upright next to the refrigerator, a bloody brown recliner in the foreground with shoes and blood puddle on the checkered floor, a cracked wall clock showing a moon face with one eye dripping blood, viewed through a circular broken mosaic tile frame with blood, dramatic cinematic lighting
